_comment: spec: plr-d10-redesign-real-integration-2026-10-25 (lane L8c-4). The ids of a task made from a spoken planned item, the same on the server (ShramSafal.Domain.Planning.PlannedWorkIds) and the phone (features/plannedWork/data/plannedWorkIds.ts). RFC 4122 UUIDv5. Name = '<log id, lower case>:plannedTasks:<item id>' (a content item) or '<log id, lower case>:job:<index>' (an item of the voice parse a 1.0.17 phone confirmed), in this namespace. 'legacyTodo' is the phone's one-time upload only: name = 'legacy-todo:<old to-do id>' in the same namespace. Values computed with the 'uuid' package (v13) and checked against the C# port.
